kurz: Some fruit belongs in the fridge, some does not: it depends on whether it keeps ripening and how sensitive it is to cold.
bild_im_kopf: Like a shared flat: whoever is noisy needs a room of their own.
was_passiert: [[w-obst|Fruit]] keeps breathing after harvest. Cold slows this down but harms fruit from warm climates: bananas turn black, tomatoes mealy and bland. Apples and ripe bananas give off [[ethylen|ethylene]] and speed up the ripening of their neighbours.
warum_wichtig: Stored properly, fruit often keeps twice as long and tastes better.
faustregeln: Never put tomatoes in the fridge if you want them to taste of anything.
schritte: Fridge: berries, cherries, grapes and ripe apples, unwashed.
Room temperature: bananas, tomatoes, avocados, stone fruit and citrus until they are ripe.
Keep apples separate so they do not ripen other fruit too early.
Wash berries only just before eating.
